issues.description: In a multi-vsys setup, you cannot create an L2-switch type sub-interface using a VLAN object from the VLAN table. The VLAN object is not accepted when configuring the sub-interface.

In PAN-OS 12.2.2, when you configure ML7-CUID in a multi-vsys environment, all vsys must use the same contributing segment ID. PAN-OS does not display a commit error or warning if you configure different contributing segment IDs across vsys, which can result in inconsistent behavior.Ensure that all vsys are configured with the same contributing segment ID before committing.
